content_sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Internship Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available under the DST-SERB project titled “Investigating the role of therapeutic compounds in fermented foods and ethnic beverages used by the Tribal population of West Bengal as a novel therapy for Helicobacter pylori and H.pylori mediated gastric ulcer”.

content_sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Internship Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification: Prior knowledge in Bioinformatics/ Computational Biology.

rows.qualification_required: Students of B.E/ B.Tech. / B.Sc. / B.S. / B.S.-M.S. / M.Sc. / M.Sc. (Integrated) / M.Sc. (Tech.)/M.Tech. of Bio-technology, Bio-Sciences Bio-informatics and related subjects with a minimum of 60% marks as per latest.

content_sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Internship Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting based on applications received, followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates. The project work will be evaluated after each month following DST-SERB project guidelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Durgapur Internship
content_sections.text: Prepare an application letter addressed to the PI or co-PI. Compile a single PDF file containing your recent CV (including email, phone number, academic qualifications, and research credentials), attested copies of all relevant testimonials, a copy of a photo ID, and one recommendation letter. Send the application via email to either [email protected] (PI) or [email protected] (co-PI). Ensure the application is submitted on or before 22 October 2026 by 5:00 PM. Wait for communication via email regarding the date and time of the online interview if shortlisted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Application letter Recent CV with email, phone number, academic qualifications, and research credentials Attested copies of all relevant testimonials Copy of photo ID proof matching the name in the CV One recommendation letter

content_sections.heading: NIT Durgapur Internship Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary and will commence no later than November 22, 2026. The internship programme is open for students studying in Indian Universities/Institutes. The project duration is 2 months (8 weeks). Project work will be evaluated after each month following DST-SERB project guidelines.

rows.details: Send application to PI or co-PI

faq.question: Q1. What is the NIT Durgapur Internship Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a temporary internship position under a DST-SERB funded project at the Department of Biotechnology, NIT Durgapur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the internship position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 22 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be students of B.E/ B.Tech. / B.Sc. / B.S. / B.S.-M.S. / M.Sc. / M.Sc. (Integrated) / M.Sc. (Tech.)/M.Tech. in Bio-technology, Bio-Sciences, Bio-informatics, or related subjects with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship amount?
faq.answer: The selected intern will receive a fellowship of Rs. 5,000/- per month.
